citations.description: Ticket comments: comment 1 is the archaeology/empirical-record comment (pre-change sidecar data); comment 2 is the rebase notice. Neither contains a post-change run attestation with a REBAR_USAGE_LOG citation.

findings.criterion: [operator-attested] a real plan-review run after the change records opus for the Pass-1 finder, cited from `REBAR_USAGE_LOG` per-step attribution (which story b690 made possible)
findings.detail: The ticket's two comments contain no concrete attestation of a live plan-review run after the change. The archaeology comment discusses historical sidecar data (pre-change) and the rebase notice discusses CI/lint status. Neither comment names a run id, a REBAR_USAGE_LOG entry, a timestamp, or any other verifiable specific showing that a post-change run recorded opus for the Pass-1 finder. The operator-attested bar requires ≥1 verifiable specific (reference id, observed log line, or timestamp); none is present.
findings.remediation: Record a concrete attestation as a ticket comment: run a real plan-review after the change, capture the REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-step attribution showing the Pass-1 finder ran on the frontier/opus model, and post the log entry (or a reference id/URL to the run artifact) with the date/time of the run.

citations.description: test_pack_prerequisite_bins_orders_and_preserves_whole_blocks uses model='test-model' with monkeypatched largest_window_tokens — does not check frontier/opus window
test_batching_never_splits_subject_or_prerequisite_block uses model=None with monkeypatched largest_window_tokens — does not check frontier/opus window
test_pass1_finder_model.py covers the Pass-1 effective model at the ProductionBatchRunner seam but contains no test about the prerequisite finder's bin packing model

findings.criterion: the prerequisite finder's bin packing is checked against opus's window, since `pack_prerequisite_bins` sizes to `cfg.model`
findings.detail: No test was found that verifies the model passed to `pack_prerequisite_bins` is the frontier/opus model (1M window). The existing tests in `test_plan_review_prerequisites.py` and `test_plan_review_prerequisites_heldout.py` all monkeypatch `largest_window_tokens` to a synthetic value and pass `model=None` or `model='test-model'` — they do not check that the prerequisite finder's bin packing is sized against the frontier/opus 1M window. The `test_pass1_finder_model.py` file (156 lines) contains no test about the prerequisite finder's bin packing. Exhaustive search across `tests/unit/` for `pack_prerequisite.*frontier`, `pack_prerequisite.*opus`, `prerequisite.*window.*frontier`, and `prerequisite.*model.*1_000_000` all returned no matches.
